extra_trails.name: Campbell Basin
extra_trails.why: 2026-11-23, approximate (open bowl, no cut strip): the 2025 trail map (skimap.org 37135) labels Campbell Basin (double diamond) in the open bowl between Hamburger and Double Ought's Right, below the ridge from The Throne to Chair 6. Trail map tied to the ground with 11 control points (thin-plate fit, leave-one-out error 80-230 m, about 160 m here); line from the ridge down the terrain fall line through the middle of that bowl (NAIP photo: open meadow) to Hamburger near the Chair 6 base. Corridor of about 150 m.

extra_trails.name: A-Basin
extra_trails.why: 2026-11-23, approximate (above the trees, open cirque): the 2025 trail map (skimap.org 37135) labels A-Basin (double diamond) below the ridge between Silver King and The Throne. Trail map tied to the ground with 11 control points (thin-plate fit, about 190 m here); line from that ridge down the terrain fall line through the open cirque (NAIP photo: bare talus and snow) to the bottom of Narnia. Corridor of about 200 m.
